provenance_note: Created after inspecting the project and after an independent review returned MODIFY. No prior pilot protocol, pilot configuration, subset manifest, log, checkpoint, or D=3/D=12 result was found. This file does not claim retrospective preregistration.

primary_experiment.seed_note: Seeds 42, 123, and 2026 were approved by the researcher before the first pilot run on 2026-10-14; they are not described as previously executed seeds.

supplementary_exploratory.name: layerwise_log_gradient_slope
supplementary_exploratory.formula: OLS slope of log10(G_l) against actual zero-based hidden-layer index l
supplementary_exploratory.interpretation_limit: Rate per hidden-layer interval, not total accumulated attenuation.

supplementary_exploratory.name: normalized_directional_gain
supplementary_exploratory.exclusion_rule: Exclude and count a sample-layer row when ||g||_2 < 1e-6.
supplementary_exploratory.interpretation_limit: Not independent of activation-gradient magnitude because J^T g is the activation gradient.

supplementary_exploratory.name: jacobian_spectrum
supplementary_exploratory.interpretation_limit: For a 10x128 Jacobian, inherent input nullity is at least 118 and is not observed rank collapse.

diagnostic_condition.purpose: Diagnostic sensitivity check for attenuation under smaller initialization scale.
diagnostic_condition.claim_limit: Not part of the primary depth contrast and not evidence of naturally occurring vanishing gradients.
diagnostic_condition.activation_rule: Enable only after primary pilot completion and only if the researcher supplies a remaining runtime budget.

stop_criteria: Stop before model execution if exact subset indices cannot be persisted.
Stop on NaN or Inf in loss, gradients, logits, Jacobians, or singular values.
Stop if a run would overwrite an existing run directory or artifact.
Stop when the approved runtime budget is exhausted.
Skip the diagnostic before sacrificing either primary arm.
Do not expand seeds, depths, learning rates, checkpoints, or steps without researcher approval.
ai_assistance: AI prepared this protocol amendment and implementation support; AI did not choose scientific conclusions or alter measured values.
